_comment: Handoff manifest for the iPhone on-device benchmark. Prepared on Windows -- NOT run. sha256 fields are placeholders to be filled in once model files are copied onto the Mac (e.g. `shasum -a 256 <file>`). See ios_benchmark/README.md and IOS_BENCHMARK_SPEC.md for full context.

models.role: fake vs filter (2-class), only runs on manipulated path

expected_output_schema.device_model: string, e.g. iPhone15,3 -- TODO fill from actual test device
expected_output_schema.ios_version: string, e.g. 17.5 -- TODO fill from actual test device
expected_output_schema.runtime: string, e.g. LiteRT/TensorFlowLiteSwift x.y.z -- TODO confirm which runtime is actually used, see IOS_BENCHMARK_SPEC.md TODO on CoreML vs LiteRT
expected_output_schema.threads: int, number of threads configured on the LiteRT interpreter -- TODO decide and record
expected_output_schema.layer2_ms: float, per-image Layer2-only inference time (manipulated path only)
expected_output_schema.end_to_end_ms: float, per-image total pipeline time (preprocessing + layer1 + [layer2] + routing)
expected_output_schema.p50: float, median end-to-end latency over the 100 timed runs
expected_output_schema.p95: float, 95th percentile end-to-end latency over the 100 timed runs
expected_output_schema.max: float, max end-to-end latency over the 100 timed runs
expected_output_schema.init_ms: float, one-time cost to load both .tflite models and allocate tensors
expected_output_schema.peak_memory_mb: float, peak resident memory during the run
expected_output_schema.prediction_consistency: float in [0,1], fraction of test images where iPhone prediction matches desktop fp32 TFLite prediction on the same image
expected_output_schema.thermal_notes: string, free text -- e.g. thermal throttling observed during 500-run stability test, device warm/hot state, etc.
